enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Remain still. Turn to back. Place arm over eyes. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Curl up. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and taking a morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Apply soap to hands. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body with soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, preparing and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Pick up kettle. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and bread. Place bread in toaster. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Remove eggs from pan. Place eggs on plate. Pick up toast. Place toast on plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: checking emails, coordinating community program logistics, and attending staff meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Greet colleagues. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Walk to meeting room. Sit in meeting room. Listen to discussion. Take notes. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Coordinate logistics. Update spreadsheet. Print documents. File documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of office. Walk to nearby cafe. Enter cafe. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: planning upcoming community programs and meeting with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open planning document. Review notes. Draft program plan. Send emails. Call partner organizations. Schedule meeting. Attend meeting with partners. Discuss program details. Take notes. Agree on action items. Return to desk. Update plan. Print plan. File plan.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channel again. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the shared living area
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from sofa. Walk to vacuum cleaner. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Put away vacuum cleaner. Pick up items on coffee table. Put items in drawer. Fluff pillows. Fold blanket.

Sit on sofa. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Select game. Start game. Press buttons. Move joystick. Play game. Pause game. Check phone. Resume game. Play game. Save game. Turn off game console. Put down controller.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing night hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with the desk lamp on and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Close eyes. Pull blanket up.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Remain still. Turn to back. Place arm over eyes. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Curl up. Remain still.
